fields.transcript: Hi this is Megan at the Channel 5 assignment desk trying to reach the airport PIO. We are getting viewer photos of flight 666 on your boards and a source in the terminal says the baggage system has been hacked. We're going live at noon with this so we need a statement from you in the next fifteen minutes. Call me back at 216 555 0155. Thanks.
fields.voiceStyle: Woman in her 30s, fast and businesslike, newsroom chatter and scanner traffic behind her
